formal: Bachelor's degree + 7 years of security management experience, OR 9 years of security management experience without degree (3 years in responsible charge)

plus.note: ASIS CPP is the de-facto credential for senior security/CSO roles in physical-and-information convergence.
First awarded in 1977; 50+ year track record.

minus.note: Cyber-only practitioners may find emphasis on physical security less directly applicable.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded seven-year experience requirement, responsible-charge duties and longstanding executive recognition support expert standing, reinforced by Japanese availability; physical-security emphasis limits its direct cyber coverage.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded accreditation, seven-year experience requirement and responsible-charge prerequisite provide a strong senior leadership filter. Physical-security-heavy multiple-choice coverage does not establish hands-on cyber expertise, but the management scope supports expert placement.

alex-novak.rationale: Seven years of verified management experience and the recorded accreditation establish substantial protection-management authority. I stop at professional because the physical-security-heavy, multiple-choice assessment does not demonstrate expert cyber practice.
